advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm click 8.4.2 is exercised against inspect-ai's actual runtime paths (not just --help) before relying on the override.
evidence: Comment: "inspect-ai — every release up to 0.3.251 — caps `click!=8.2.0,<8.2.2,>=8.1.3`"
Compatibility is asserted via manual CLI checks ("`inspect --help` ... work under click 8.4.2"), not enforced by the resolver
No upper bound constrains the override; the lock currently resolves to 8.4.2 but the floor permits any later version
advisory.finding: The uv `override-dependencies = ["click>=8.3.3"]` deliberately overrides inspect-ai's declared cap `click!=8.2.0,<8.2.2,>=8.1.3`, bypassing an upstream-declared compatibility constraint; if the cap reflected a real incompatibility, the resolver would no longer protect against it and breakage would only surface at runtime.
merged_from: The override floor `click>=8.3.3` is open-ended, so future `uv lock` runs can silently drift click forward to any newer major/minor release, potentially introducing breaking changes or new advisories without review.
scenarios: inspect-ai 0.3.251 is used under click 8.4.2 in a code path not exercised by the manual --help checks

coaching.coaching: File a follow-on ticket (discovered_from this change) for the inspect-ai click-cap override removal trigger, a pre-existing / out-of-scope issue — do not fix it in this change.
